shared_anchors: C-23 Canal Estuary Discharge Diversion Project in Palm City
Gov. Ron DeSantis announcement/celebration event on Wednesday
Project diverted nearly 5 billion gallons since May operational testing
Reroutes water from C-23 Canal away from St. Lucie Estuary
novel_facts: Additional quotes from DeSantis, Drew Bartlett, and Alexis Lambert
Specific technical details: 166 million gallons per day capacity, 6.3 billion gallons expected diversion
Nutrient reduction projections: 55,000 pounds nitrogen, 14,000 pounds phosphorus annually
Quote from local resident Newton Cook about clean water
Seven miles of new canal mentioned
Reference to C-23/C-24 Stormwater Treatment Area completion
Context about 2016 and 2018 algae outbreaks
Discussion of EAA reservoir timeline acceleration to 2029
material_update_promotion_decisions.reason: Both articles cover the exact same event: Gov. DeSantis's Wednesday announcement celebrating completion of the C-23 Canal diversion project in Palm City, with the identical key fact of 5 billion gallons diverted since May. The incoming article provides additional background, context, quotes, and technical specifications, but no material new development. The novel facts are expansions on the same story (more official quotes, historical context, related projects mentioned at same event) rather than a material update like a new action, finding, or consequence. This is standard same-day coverage from a different outlet with more detail but no change in what readers need to know about the event itself.
